requirement.description: {data_dave} noted that the ingestion pipeline costs are a concern for the team. He would accept a manual ingestion step if it saves money on the infrastructure.
requirement.fact: {data_dave} noted that the ingestion pipeline costs are a concern for the team.
requirement.reading: He would accept a manual ingestion step if it saves money on the infrastructure.

speaker.name: Data Dave
speaker.role: Builds secure, scalable data pipelines and manages storage infrastructure. Focuses on high-quality data operations and robust data governance. Collaborates on exploring data and managing data quality to support model development.

output.objection: You are framing this as a cost saving, but you are actually asking me to take on manual data quality checks that will break under load. I need you to acknowledge that this shifts the risk of silent data corruption onto my team.
output.correction: I did not say I would accept manual ingestion because it is cheaper for you. I said the current automated pipeline is over built for the volume we actually handle, and I want to discuss right sizing it before we talk about cost.
